items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Thomas Joe Cormoth was supposed to come in the next day to go Beaumont for a funeral

ctx.x: Well, both of her lungs collapsed, and they had to give her pneumotherapy, build her lungs up, and this is what happened with her. It was a lung condition. She had a hemorrhage. Just a cough -- she gave a cough and spat up blood about the size of a quarter, hit the runner in our place out there on Peacock. And she said heu-eu-um. Thomas Joe Cormoth was supposed to come in the next day to go Beaumont for a funeral, and my wife had talked to Laverne that evening about 5:00 o'clock, cooking dinner. And she said,…
whose birthday February 12th, 1970, on (inaudible). Was that on the 12th of February?
